command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj X86-P82-alu-imm.s -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input, one LF-terminated line each (`EXP-0113` §2): the `imm8` row and the full-width row of each ALU mnemonic at its widths, plus the 64-bit `%rax` short forms of `and`/`or`/`xor`/`cmp`. Thirty-six instructions, 176 bytes in all; every operand is a register or an immediate, so no relocation record is emitted. The `%rax` forms carry only the immediate operand because the accumulator is implicit in the form.
source: `llvm-mc` 23.1.2 selection; the `imm8` vs full-width choice is `EC-01`, the accumulator vs ModRM choice is `EC-04`, the operand-size prefix is `EC-07`, and the three-bit register window is `EC-01`. The measured bytes match the templates the generator appends as `definitions/x86_64/0.76.0.json`.
